component.name: Apache InLong
component.description: Data integration platform. The security model defines explicit security boundaries aligned with module design roles: the Sort module performs real-time data synchronization across trusted databases, and the Manager module provides tenant isolation with a permission framework in which only Group owners can modify or delete their Groups, Sinks, Streams, and associated data.

externalReferences.comment: Source security model document; this file is a structured translation of it.

threats.name: Malicious data in databases read by the Sort module
threats.description: The Sort module handles real-time data synchronization, reading and writing across trusted databases. The system assumes database sources are secure; malicious data within databases constitutes unsafe input outside the module's threat model. Users must independently validate data sources and authenticate access origins.

threats.name: Access to collective business information within a tenant
threats.description: The Manager module provides tenant isolation. Within a single tenant, all members can access collective business information including Groups, Sinks, and Streams; under the established permission framework, only Group owners can modify or delete their respective Groups, Sinks, Streams, and associated data. Members performing authorized operations remain within security boundaries, so intra-tenant visibility is not a vulnerability; users should restrict tenant membership to prevent unauthorized information access.

controls.name: Validate data sources and authenticate access origins
controls.description: Users of the Sort module must independently validate data sources and authenticate access origins, since the module assumes the databases it reads from and writes to are secure.

controls.name: Restrict tenant membership
controls.description: Restrict tenant membership in the Manager module to prevent unauthorized access to the tenant's collective business information (Groups, Sinks, Streams).

controls.name: Group-owner permission framework
controls.description: Under the Manager module's permission framework, only Group owners can modify or delete their respective Groups, Sinks, Streams, and associated data.
